sentimento.text1: 📈 THE GAP IN THE WINNER CONTRACT WIDENED FROM 9.25pp TO 10.20pp, and this time only one side moved: Flávio Bolsonaro rose from 53.75% to 54.70% (vol USD 10.88M accumulated) and Lula stayed at the same 44.50% (vol USD 11.19M accumulated), confirmed reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, against the price confirmed on Sep 16. The 54.70% sits 0.40pp below Flávio's series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10. Lula's 44.50% sits 23.00pp below his series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16.
sentimento.text2: 🗳️ THREE NATIONAL POLLS WERE RELEASED ON Sep 17, AtlasIntel, PoderData and Gerp, and in the runoff between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula each house repeats the distance of its own previous round: 2 points in PoderData, 46% to 44%, as on Sep 10; 7 points in Gerp, 50% to 43%, as on Sep 9; and 0.4 point in AtlasIntel, 47.2% to 46.8%, against 0.2 on Sep 10. All three put Flávio Bolsonaro numerically ahead. ⚠️ The difference BETWEEN the houses, from 0.4 to 7 points, is larger than the movement of any of them against itself: in PoderData and AtlasIntel the pair fits inside the margins and is a statistical tie, and in Gerp it falls outside two margins. In the first round the one that moves is AtlasIntel, where Lula's lead over Flávio Bolsonaro narrowed from 5.6 to 2.4 points.
sentimento.text3: 📅 THE REGISTRY OF THE SUPERIOR ELECTORAL COURT set five national polls for Sep 17. Three of them are published and enter this round, AtlasIntel, PoderData and Gerp. Datafolha and 100 Cidades also have a release set for today, and their numbers do not enter this round. The 40,500-interview Veritá is set for Sep 18, two Palver waves for Sep 20, and Quaest, Nexus and American Analytics for Sep 21. A registration is a commitment to release, not a published number.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 54.70% in the winner contract, up 0.95pp against the price confirmed on Sep 16, 0.40pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10. In the three national polls of Sep 17 he appears ahead in the runoff against Lula: 47.2% to 46.8% in AtlasIntel, 46% to 44% in PoderData and 50% to 43% in Gerp. In the first-round runner-up contract he rises 1.00pp, to 76.50%.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 44.50% in the winner contract, with no movement against the price confirmed on Sep 16, 23.00pp below his series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16. In the first round he leads in AtlasIntel, 44.1% to 41.7%, and in PoderData, 37% to 36%, and trails in Gerp, 37% to 40%. In the first-round runner-up contract he gives up 1.20pp, to 22.65%.
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 IN THE FIRST-ROUND THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT RENAN SANTOS MOVED AHEAD OF AUGUSTO CURY: he rises 7.50pp, to 44.00%, while Cury falls 2.60pp, to 42.90%, and Ronaldo Caiado falls 3.00pp, to 12.50%, against the values confirmed on Sep 16. Today's polls do not agree on that order: AtlasIntel puts Renan Santos ahead, 5.1% to 3.5%, and PoderData and Gerp put Augusto Cury ahead, 8% to 3% and 7% to 2%. The panel does not claim the book reacted to any of them.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT (16:21 UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and certification is per book: in this round all five tracked contracts were confirmed, winner, runner-up, first-round third place, Supreme Court impeachment and Senate. Presidential book at USD 150.87M accumulated.

inss.text1: 🔴 THERE IS NO NEW ACT IN THE INSS FRAUD INQUIRY ON Sep 17. What stands is still the act of Sep 12, in which Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and the procedural suspension he ordered also reaches the INSS cases, without changing their rapporteur.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 What links the INSS to the Master case here is procedural, not factual: both sets are suspended by the same decision, and the trial the full court opened on it on Sep 15 was suspended by Flávio Dino's request for more time to review the case, with no decision.
inss.impactoLula: There are two recent structured readings of government approval, from different houses and methods, and they do not compare as a series. The AtlasIntel poll of Sep 17, with fieldwork from Sep 11 to 16 by online questionnaire, measures 45.4% approval against 53.6% disapproval and 0.9% no answer. The Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14, with fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13, measured 43% against 50% and 7% who do not know, and on the management scale 32% positive, 27% fair, 38% negative and 3% no answer.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on Aug 05, 46% against 48% on Aug 14, 45% against 48% on Sep 02, 43% against 50% on Sep 07 and 43% against 50% on Sep 14. The 5-point fall in approval over about a month stopped in the latest round. ⭐ On the management scale, the Sep 14 release brings 32% positive rating, 27% regular and 38% negative, with 3% not answering, and that is the breakdown the block now uses, with a single date.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the topic is about evaluation and calendar, not acts: there is no new act in the INSS fraud inquiry on Sep 17, the judgment on the suspension that reaches those cases remains stalled on the review request of Sep 15, and the AtlasIntel poll of Sep 17 brings a second reading of government approval.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 ON Sep 17 EDSON FACHIN REMOVED FROM THE Sep 23 AGENDA THE JUDGMENT OF THE REQUEST TO INVESTIGATE THE CONDUCT OF ANDRÉ MENDONÇA as rapporteur of the Master case, without setting a new date. The analysis on investigating Alexandre de Moraes over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro remains suspended since Sep 15 by a review request from Flávio Dino, who has up to 90 days to return the case (Poder360 and Gazeta do Povo).
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE CHRONOLOGY THE RECORD SUPPORTS: on Sep 12 Fachin took over as rapporteur and suspended the cases; on Sep 14 the Federal Police delivered to the justices' offices the full data extracted from Vorcaro's phone, André Mendonça lifted the secrecy of the data on Banco Master's payment network and Moraes filed with Fachin a 121-point petition asking for the immediate closure of the investigation; on Sep 15 the full court opened the judgment on Moraes and Dino requested review; on Sep 17 Fachin, as president of the Supreme Court, took the judgment on Mendonça off the Sep 23 agenda. ⚠️ Vorcaro's testimony to the Federal Police is rescheduled for Sep 24, at the defense's request. Vorcaro is held at Papudinha, in the Federal District.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page is from the reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT. In that reading the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 5.05%, with USD 91 thousand accumulated, 0.20pp above the 4.85% of Sep 16 and with USD 199 of new money since the previous day. It is a thin book, and the panel does not attribute the move to the removal from the agenda.
bancoMaster.conclusao: What changes from Sep 16 to 17 is the calendar, not the merits: the two requests to investigate Supreme Court justices are left without a date, Moraes's with Dino for up to 90 days and Mendonça's off the Sep 23 agenda, and Vorcaro's testimony remains set for Sep 24. The panel records the procedure and the price, without saying which of the two better describes the outcome.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act confirmed by two independent sources on Sep 17. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos.
stf.moraes: On Sep 15 the full court discussed whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, and the review was suspended by Flávio Dino's request for more time, with no decision on opening the investigation. On the night of Sep 14 he had filed with Fachin a 121-point petition asking for the immediate dismissal of the investigation.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act confirmed by two independent sources on Sep 17. On Sep 14 his office received from the Federal Police the full data extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone.
stf.dino: On Sep 15 he asked for more time to review the trial on the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the review for up to 90 days. Before the session, he sent Fachin a request to investigate possible links between André Mendonça and Daniel Vorcaro.
stf.mendonca: On Sep 17 Edson Fachin removed from the Sep 23 agenda the judgment of the request to investigate his conduct as rapporteur of the Master case, and the analysis is left without a date. On Sep 14 he had lifted the secrecy of the data on Banco Master's payment network, after a request from Fachin and a favorable opinion from the Prosecutor General's Office.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome. The two requests to investigate Supreme Court justices tied to the Master case are now without a date: Alexandre de Moraes's stalled on a review request since Sep 15, and André Mendonça's removed from the Sep 23 agenda on Sep 17. In the reading of Sep 17 the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 5.05%, 0.20pp above the previous day, with USD 199 of new money in the book. The panel does not claim the procedure moved the price.
stf.analise: 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 5.05% (vol USD 91 thousand accumulated), confirmed reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, 0.20pp above the 4.85% of the price confirmed on Sep 16. ⚠️ The accumulated volume grew USD 199 since the previous day, so today's move happened in a book with almost no new money. It remains 21.05pp below the series high, of 26.10% on Sep 11, and 2.95pp above the floor, of 2.10% on Jun 8.
stf.fachin: On Sep 17, as president of the Supreme Court, he removed from the Sep 23 agenda the judgment of the request to investigate the conduct of André Mendonça as rapporteur of the Master case, without setting a new date (Poder360 and Gazeta do Povo). On Sep 15 he had opened, as rapporteur, the judgment on the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes, which ended with no decision, with Flávio Dino's review request.
